subject: VeloTech: QnA fragment roll‑forward + portal ownership transfer
messages:
From: Elena Rios <e.rios@velotech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: security@velotech.com
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: VeloTech security portal onboarding — SIG export and environment details

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday. We want to get Redwood live in our vendor program this month. Our security intake team prefers evidence in Vendr + Whistic, and we do a scoped CAIQ/SIG import for higher‑risk vendors. Can you confirm whether Redwood can:  

- Provide a partial SIG/CAIQ export (JSON) that we can import into Vendr (we only need controls related to data residency, encryption, and access control)
- Share a short system architecture diagram and the SOC 2 cert or a SOC 2 letter for 2026–2027 period
- Identify a technical contact we can add to our OneTrust/Whistic portals so our team can request attachments programmatically

Ideal timeline: receive a fragment export + diagram by Aug 6 so we can complete our intake by Aug 10.

I attached our upload instructions and the vendor onboarding checklist. If helpful we can do a 30‑minute screen share on Friday to walk through portal roles and the import flow.

Thanks,
Elena Rios
Head of Vendor Risk, VeloTech
Elena.Rios@velotech.com

Attachment: VeloTech-Questionnaire-Upload-Instructions.pdf
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rios <e.rios@velotech.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: VeloTech security portal onboarding — SIG export and environment details

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask. We can definitely support a scoped SIG/CAIQ fragment suitable for Vendr import and upload the SOC 2 letter + architecture diagram. Quick plan:  

1) I will produce a JSON fragment containing the controls you requested (data residency, encryption, access control) and upload the artifact to the link you provided. Marissa will QA the fragment for accuracy.
2) Mina will attach the SOC 2 attestation and a one‑page infra diagram (S3/KMS boundaries, VPC peering notes)
3) We will provision a portal service account for OneTrust/Whistic API access (read+upload) and share the service account email and minimal permission instructions.

Target: send the SIG fragment + diagram by end of day Aug 6; we can schedule a 30m walkthrough on Aug 6 or 7. Please let me know which slot you prefer — I see availability 8/6 11–12 PDT or 8/7 09–10 PDT.

CCing Mina and Marissa who will own the artifacts and upload.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Sr. Security Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment (outbound): redwood-sig-fragment-20270804.json (partial export, controls filtered)
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Aug 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: VeloTech security portal onboarding — action items + upload checklist

Forwarding Elena's note — adding a short checklist and owners so we don't miss anything:  

- Marissa: Validate the SIG fragment mapping (Vendr field names: control_id, control_summary, response, evidence_urls). Confirm no PII in the JSON export.
- Marissa: Create a one‑page infra diagram (PDF) that clearly marks encryption boundary and where customer data may reside.
- Jonas: Create a service account and a minimal role ('vendor-portal-uploader@redwood.com') and share the key/permissions with VeloTech security team. Document mitigation for API throttling.
- Mina: I'll attach the SOC 2 letter and the CAIQ control IDs mapping sheet.

Note on evidence: for items we can't upload to Vendr we will provide signed attestation PDF and point to the internal S3 evidence manifest (internal link only). For external upload, use the Drive folder we have in the related_links list.

I will start the SOC 2 packaging today and post the files into the shared drive. Marissa — ping me if you want me to draft the attestation language for controls where we use compensating tech measures.

—Mina

Jonas / Mina / Marissa —

Thanks — that timeline works. Let's do the walkthrough on Aug 6 at 11:00 PDT (I'll send a calendar invite in a minute). I confirmed our portal will accept the Vendr JSON fragment; if you can upload the fragment and the SOC 2 letter to the Drive folder and then kick the import from our side we should be able to complete verification by Aug 10.

One small ask: can you include a short statement (one paragraph) confirming Redwood does not retain customer encryption keys and that KMS is customer‑controlled for private deployments? We include that as a required field in our intake for vendors with access to customer data.

I attached our DocuSign link for the data processing addendum; please route to legal if required.

Appreciate the rapid turnaround — looking forward to the session.

Elena
